$comment: Text pool for the Travel prayer category.
requests: Flying to Atlanta Monday for work. Pray for safe travel.
Safe travels for our family road trip to San Diego this weekend.
My son is deploying with his unit next week. Pray for his safety, for his wife and baby at home, and for the day he comes back.
Our daughter is spending the semester studying in Spain. It is her first time out of the country. Pray for her safety, good friends, and wisdom.
We are driving to Colorado to see my parents over the holidays. It is a long drive with three little kids. Pray for safe roads and patient hearts.
My husband travels for work almost every week. Pray for his safety on the road and in the air, and for our family while he is gone.
Leaving Saturday on a short mission trip to Mexico with our youth group. Pray for safety, good health, and for us to serve with humble hearts.
My friend is flying home to the Philippines to see her family for the first time in six years. Pray for safe flights and a sweet reunion.
My grandpa is 84 and determined to drive to Albuquerque by himself to see his sister. Pray for his safety and for him to take lots of breaks.
Lord, please watch over my nephew as he comes home from deployment this month. Bring him home safely and help him adjust to life back home.
Heading out on a two-week trip to visit family back East. Pray for safe travel, good health, and a restful visit.
Our teenage son is driving to Flagstaff with friends for the first time. I am nervous. Pray for safe roads and good choices.
A few of us from work are traveling overseas for a conference. Pray for safe flights, smooth connections, and for me to be a good witness to my coworkers.

My daughter and son-in-law are flying to Kenya next month with a small team from church to help at a school there. It is their first trip like this. They will be gone three weeks, and we will be watching their kids. Pray for safe flights, good health, open hearts, and that they would come home changed. And pray for us, because three grandkids for three weeks is a lot of energy.

My wife and I are driving from Phoenix to Ohio to help my mom after her surgery. It is about 30 hours on the road and we will split it over three days. The truck is older and we are praying it holds up. Pray for safe roads, good weather, alert minds behind the wheel, and peace for my mom until we get there.
details: Pray for safety on the road and in the air, and for peace for those waiting at home.
Travel always makes me a little anxious, so I would appreciate prayer for calm.
Pray for good health while away and for the trip to go smoothly.
"Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in" (Psalm 121:8, WEB). Holding on to this one.
Pray for patience with any delays and for everyone to arrive rested.
Thank you for praying. It brings real comfort to know others are covering us.
answers: Made it safely! Thank you for praying.
Home safe and sound. God was with us every mile.
Arrived safely, with only a few small delays. Thank you, church family.
So far everything is going well. Keep praying for the rest of the way.
Still waiting on the return, but we are at peace. Thank you.
Praise God for safe travel and a good trip. Your prayers were felt.
